name: com.tixsight/tixsight-free-tools
title: TixSight free tools
description: Free ticket resale math, no account needed: break-even listing price and net payout after fees.

tools.name: break_even_price
tools.description: The listing price per ticket needed to break even on resale tickets after the seller fee, with the net per ticket at that price and a one-line explanation. Works without an account. TixSight (tixsight.com) tracks this automatically for a whole ticket inventory.

cost_per_ticket.description: What you paid per ticket, in US dollars, including any fees you paid when buying.

seller_fee_percent.description: Seller fee the resale site takes out of your payout, as a percent of the listed price (default 10).

buyer_fee_percent.description: Buyer fee, as a percent of the listed price (default 0). Buyer fees sit on top of the listed price: the buyer pays them, so they don't change your break-even. The answer shows what the buyer pays.

extra_costs.description: Other costs for the whole order in US dollars, such as delivery (default 0). Spread evenly over the tickets.

tools.name: net_payout
tools.description: What you keep from a ticket sale after the seller fee: net per ticket and in total, and the profit or loss per ticket and in total when you give your cost. Works without an account. TixSight (tixsight.com) tracks this automatically for a whole ticket inventory.

list_price.description: Listed (sale) price per ticket, in US dollars, before any buyer fee.

seller_fee_percent.description: Seller fee the resale site takes out of your payout, as a percent of the listed price (default 10).

cost_per_ticket.description: Optional: what you paid per ticket, in US dollars, for the profit or loss.
